name: Targeting Ofuda
body:
Sutra Type warding

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft. per sutra caster level)
Target one creature

EFFECT

Duration 1 round per effective spell level
Saving Throw: none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The ofuda flies off and attaches to the target to actually help guide attacks on the target with magical ch’i energy. It grants a +1 insight bonus to attack to any creature attacking the target of this ofuda. Against infernals, attackers gain an additional +1 for every four sutra caster levels. Against other creatures, attackers gain an additional +1 for every eight sutra caster levels. This sutra is only half as effective against any non-infernal creature targeted by this sutra (minimum attack bonus of +1). This sutra lasts for a number of rounds equal to its effective spell level; the caster may voluntarily dismiss it as a free action.
